title: Bank of Canada: Energy risks complicate October decision - RBC
summary: Rachel Battaglia at Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) argues that higher backward-looking population growth implies stronger potential output, mechanically reducing pressure on the Bank of Canada (BoC) to hike rates.

title: Canadian Dollar dips to fresh two-month lows amid higher US yields, Fed hiking bets
summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) extends losses for the fourth consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, as surging US Treasury yields and rising bets of Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes are propelling the Greenback across the board.

title: Canada Retail Sales Fall Broadly in July, but August Advance Points to Rebound
summary: Canadian retail sales swung from +0.6% to -0.7% m/m in July, slightly better than expectations for a 0.8% decline, while sales excluding autos fell from +0.5% to -0.7%, weaker than the -0.5% consensus. The headline weakness was broad, with sales falling in eight of nine subsectors, while retail volumes declined an even steeper 1.1%. title: Silver price falls as Fed hawkish outlook drives US yields higher
summary: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its decline on Thursday, falling 1.23% on the day to trade around $63.65 at the time of writing.

title: Swedish Krona: Riksbank hawkish hold backs currency – BBH
summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Swedish Krona (SEK) rallied after the Riksbank delivered a hawkish hold, keeping rates unchanged but signaling more tightening ahead.
